The '''Treaty of Bokevrek''' was the 1935 settlement that ended the [[Bakorian War]] and formalized Astoria's annexation of eastern Bakoria.

== Terms ==

The treaty recognized Astorian control over eastern Bakoria, including [[Azmetan]]. It also established demilitarized zones along the new border and imposed military restrictions on the remaining Bakorian authorities.

== Consequences ==

The treaty turned Astoria's battlefield victory into a territorial settlement. It weakened Bakoria, damaged confidence in [[Northern Alliance]] guarantees, and contributed to regional militarization before the [[Avant Great War]].

The treaty's harsh legacy also fed anti-Astorian politics in neighboring states and helped set conditions for the [[Pesteran-Astorian War]].
